title: David’s Oven-Reduced Tomato Sauce
description: A deep, long-cooked tomato sauce built on onion, carrot, celery, garlic, toasted tomato paste, red wine, and Parmesan, then slowly reduced in the oven.
ingredients: Cooking fat as needed for sautéing
steps: Heat a large oven-safe pot or roasting vessel and sauté the onion, carrot, and celery until softened and aromatic.
Add the garlic and cook briefly, just until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste and cook it until it darkens slightly and loses its raw taste.
Add the crushed tomatoes and blend to the desired consistency.
Season the sauce, add the red wine, and stir in Parmesan.
Transfer the sauce to the oven with the lid cracked so moisture can escape.
Reduce for 4–6 hours, stirring periodically, until the sauce has dropped roughly 2–3 inches in the pot and reached the desired richness and consistency.
Taste and adjust the final seasoning before serving, cooling, or portioning for storage.
notes: The oven reduction is the defining move. The long, gentle reduction concentrates the tomato without requiring constant stovetop attention. Stir more frequently as the sauce gets thicker near the end.
